query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*)                                    AS "total_matches!: i64",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 0)          AS "wins!: i64",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 1)          AS "losses!: i64",
                COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE result = 2)          AS "draws!: i64",
                MAX(created_at)                             AS "last_played: DateTime<Utc>"
            FROM elo_history
            WHERE user_id     = $1
              AND opponent_id = $2
